The '''''Harbinger''''' was an [[Assault ship/Legends|assault ship]] owned and piloted by [[Bel Att]] while he worked for the [[Nalroni/Legends|Nalroni]] crimelord [[Sprax]]. [[Limna Yith]] stole the ship and used it as a ship for her mercenary work.
